summary: Redemption suggestions use only the selected live account's identity, balance, and history.
reason: The shared local redemption and balance mirrors have no account owner, so a profile switch could show the previous account's data.
validated_outcome: Local HTTP tests switch accounts after seeding unowned mirror and response-cache data; suggestions show only the authenticated account. Tests cover enveloped and bare-array history responses. Authentication and network errors return no stale data.
safety: The command requires live read access and fails closed instead of falling back to unowned local rows. Tests use only a local mock server.
